title: Billing and Coding: Cardiac Rhythm Device Evaluation

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT codes: 93279, 93280, 93281, 93286, 93288, 93293, 93294, 93296 and 93724.
covered.2: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT codes: 93260, 93261, 93282, 93283, 93284, 93287, 93289, 93292, 93295 and 93296. All diagnoses listed under Pacemakers may apply to these codes, as well.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
